description: Compare theme configuration between two stores: JSON templates, section groups and settings_data.json (default files: templates/*.json, sections/*.json, config/settings_data.json). Use it for theme settings; use diff_stores for store data such as metafields, metaobjects and pages. Compares the published themes unless source_theme or target_theme give theme ids. Returns file counts (onlyInSource, changed, onlyInTarget, identical), the files on one side only, and for each changed file the settings that differ with both values (first 100 per file); format="markdown" gives a report. Use ignore_settings to quiet settings that differ on purpose. Never writes to a theme; both stores need the read_themes scope.

exclude.description: Theme file patterns to leave out, e.g. ["templates/gift_card.json"].

format.description: "markdown" returns a report to paste into a ticket or an email.

ignore_settings.description: Settings to leave out, as globs on their path, optionally limited to files: ["current.sections.header.*", "config/settings_data.json:current.color_*"]. Use it to quiet settings that differ on purpose between stores.

source.description: Store alias to compare from (snapshot folders hold no themes).

name: diff_themes
title: Compare theme settings
